items.statement: Strategies that combine a prompt to patients with feedback to clinicians increase completed and clinician-reviewed measures per visit more than either alone.
items.rationale: Prompts act on completion and feedback on review; the executive's choice is between them.

items.statement: Increases in measure use fall back within a year of support ending unless a local champion remains.
items.rationale: Two studies point this way; durability decides value for money.
items.risks: Follow-up after support is rarely reported.

items.statement: Higher clinician-reviewed measure use is associated with higher six-month remission.
items.rationale: Links uptake to outcome through treatment changes.

summary: Three review hypotheses; h1 selected as the primary comparison.
